interpretation_rule: This is an explanatory glossary, never an executable signal definition or recommendation. The named reference data does not prove an edge.

indicator_entries.name: Open high low close volume (OHLCV)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: A completed bar reports open, highest traded price, lowest traded price, close, and traded volume for a defined interval.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Base input for many indicators, but not an order book or a record of individual trade initiators.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Point-in-time timestamped bars and unit-adjustment metadata.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: A partial bar is not completed; OHLCV alone cannot reconstruct within-bar event ordering.

indicator_entries.name: Simple return
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: r_t=P_t/P_{t-1}-1 for a consistent adjusted price basis.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Price performance over a specified interval.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Price-only return is not total return when distributions matter.

indicator_entries.name: Log return
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: ln(P_t/P_{t-1}); additive across time for valid positive prices.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Useful for statistical modeling and volatility.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Do not casually sum percentage returns as log returns.

indicator_entries.name: Total return
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Price change plus cash distributions on a declared reinvestment convention.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Ex-date and payable-date/dividend data, corporate actions.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Total-return indices and raw close are not interchangeable.

indicator_entries.name: Gap return
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: O_t/C_{t-1}-1 on a consistent split/dividend basis.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Overnight price changes or opening dislocations.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Session opens, previous completed closes, corporate actions.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Gap observation at open cannot justify a fill at that same known open unless causally executable.

indicator_entries.name: Intraday open-to-close return
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: C_t/O_t-1.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Regular-session movement after the opening print.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Final close is not known at the open; separate after-hours returns.

indicator_entries.name: High-low range
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: H_t-L_t or (H_t-L_t)/P_reference.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: High-before-low sequence is unknown from one OHLC bar.

indicator_entries.name: Typical price
indicator_entries.interpretation: Common price input for CCI/MFI/VWAP approximations.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Bar typical price does not equal trade-by-trade VWAP.

indicator_entries.name: Median price
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Not the median of all transactions.

indicator_entries.name: Internal Bar Strength (IBS)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: (C-L)/(H-L) when H>L.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Close location within the session range.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: H=L requires a declared zero-range policy; close location is not signed order flow.

indicator_entries.name: Close location value (CLV)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: ((C-L)-(H-C))/(H-L) when H>L.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Close near range top (+1) or bottom (-1).
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Zero-range policy required; no proof of buyers/sellers by participant type.

indicator_entries.name: True range
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: max(H-L,abs(H-C_prev),abs(L-C_prev)).
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Current completed HLC and previous completed close.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Prior close adjustment/market sessions must be consistent.

indicator_entries.name: Simple moving average (SMA)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: SMA_n(t)=(1/n) sum of n completed prices ending at t.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Smooths price and defines lagged trend state.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: At least n valid completed comparable closes.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Crossing above SMA is not automatically an edge; avoid unconfirmed intrabar signals.

indicator_entries.name: Exponential moving average (EMA)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: EMA_t=alpha*P_t+(1-alpha)*EMA_prev; alpha=2/(n+1) for common convention.
indicator_entries.interpretation: More responsive price smoothing than SMA.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: EMA initialization alters early history; parameter n does not uniquely define every implementation.

indicator_entries.name: Wilder smoothed moving average (RMA/SMMA)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: RMA_t=(RMA_prev*(n-1)+X_t)/n after declared seeding.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Not interchangeable with EMA alpha=2/(n+1).

indicator_entries.name: Weighted moving average (WMA)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Weighted trailing mean favoring more recent samples.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Weight choice is behavior-bearing.

indicator_entries.name: Volume-weighted moving average (VWMA)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: sum(P_i*V_i)/sum(V_i) over trailing n bars.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: VWMA across bars is not exact session VWAP from transactions.

indicator_entries.name: Double / triple exponential MA (DEMA/TEMA)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: DEMA=2EMA(P)-EMA(EMA(P)); TEMA=3EMA-3EMA2+EMA3.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Complete price history and EMA definitions.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: May amplify noise; smoothing seed matters.

indicator_entries.name: Hull moving average (HMA)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: WMA(sqrt(n), 2WMA(n/2)-WMA(n)); rounding policy must be fixed.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Rounding, warmup and backfilling can change signals.

indicator_entries.name: Moving-average slope
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: MA_t-MA_{t-k} or normalized slope by lagged scale.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Trend slopes use lagged observations; scale and horizon matter.

indicator_entries.name: Moving-average crossover
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Fast_MA_t crosses Slow_MA_t using t and t-1 values.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Event expressing recent trend overtaking longer trend.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Fully declared fast/slow MAs, event clock.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Cross event is a signal recipe, not an indicator's guarantee of profitability.

indicator_entries.name: Price versus trend gate
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: C_t compared with trailing MA or prior n-day level.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: At close t, earliest standard execution is a later executable event.

indicator_entries.name: Donchian channel
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Upper=max(H_{t-n}...H_{t-1}); Lower=min(L_{t-n}...L_{t-1}) for prior-window breakout.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Including current high in its own breakout boundary creates self-reference.

indicator_entries.name: Aroon up/down
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: 100*(n-bars_since_n_bar_high)/n and analogous low, with a pinned convention.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Off-by-one and ties matter; not price momentum by itself.

indicator_entries.name: Parabolic SAR
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Recursive acceleration/stop-and-reverse trailing level; parameters and initial state required.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Cannot infer intrabar stops/fills from OHLC without an accepted ambiguity model.

indicator_entries.name: Ichimoku Tenkan/Kijun
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Midpoint of highest high and lowest low over declared short/medium windows.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Completed high low and window sizes.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Cloud spans plotted in future chart positions must not read future market prices.

indicator_entries.name: Ichimoku cloud (Senkou/Chikou)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Cloud uses midpoint components displaced for plotting; lagging line plots older observations.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Timestamp-aligned component history and displacement metadata.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Plot shift must not be mistaken for information available earlier.

indicator_entries.name: Supertrend
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Trailing ATR-based regime band with recursive directional state.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Trend regime and trailing stop proxy.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Implementation conventions differ; no simultaneous same-bar favorable fills.

indicator_entries.name: Linear-regression slope
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: OLS slope over trailing n prices or log prices.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Trend estimate with declared units/time axis.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Historical fit is not future performance; residual assumptions matter.

indicator_entries.name: ADX / directional movement
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: +DM/-DM and ATR-smoothed +DI/-DI; ADX smooths DX=100*abs(+DI--DI)/(+DI+-DI).
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: ADX magnitude does not say bullish/bearish; division zero needs declared policy.

indicator_entries.name: Vortex indicator
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Positive/negative movement sums divided by trailing true-range sums.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Sensitive to gaps and adjustment history.

indicator_entries.name: Rate of change (ROC)
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Short and long horizons can have opposite signs.

indicator_entries.name: Relative Strength Index (RSI)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: 100-100/(1+RS), RS=Wilder-smoothed positive change / smoothed negative change.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Bounded momentum, often used to describe overextended states.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Thresholds and overbought/oversold interpretations are hypotheses, not automatic rules; zero-loss convention required.

indicator_entries.name: Connors RSI / RSI2
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Composite or short-period RSI variant; Connors RSI usually combines price RSI, streak RSI and percent-rank change.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Fully specified periods/percentile method and closes.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: RSI2 and Connors RSI are distinct; don't conflate or invent thresholds.

indicator_entries.name: Stochastic oscillator %K/%D
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: %K=100*(C-L_n)/(H_n-L_n); %D=smoothing of %K.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Zero-range policy and smoothing method needed.

indicator_entries.name: Stochastic RSI
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Normalized RSI within its own trailing min/max range.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Not the same as price stochastic.

indicator_entries.name: MACD
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: MACD=EMA_fast-EMA_slow; Signal=EMA(MACD,signal_n); histogram=MACD-signal.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Completed prices, periods and EMA warmup.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Positive histogram does not establish a profitable buy signal.

indicator_entries.name: Commodity Channel Index (CCI)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: (TypicalPrice-SMA(TypicalPrice))/(0.015*mean_abs_deviation) for common convention.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: 0.015 is convention, not universally frozen; mean absolute deviation vs standard deviation matters.

indicator_entries.name: Williams %R
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Equivalent structure to stochastic under scaling; duplicate ideas may be semantic neighbors.

indicator_entries.name: True Strength Index (TSI)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Ratio of double-smoothed price changes to double-smoothed absolute changes.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Warmup and zero denominator require rules.

indicator_entries.name: Ultimate oscillator
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Weighted combination of buying pressure/true range over three horizons.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: No universal bullish divergence guarantee.

indicator_entries.name: Money Flow Index (MFI)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Ratio of positive/negative typical-price*volume money flow over trailing window.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Trade-side flow is not actually observed; classification by typical-price change is proxy.

indicator_entries.name: Momentum streak / consecutive up-down bars
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Count successive positive/negative completed close changes or directional bar bodies.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Rule is behavior-dependent on zero-change handling.

indicator_entries.name: Rolling realized volatility
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Annualized standard deviation of past returns, e.g. sd(r_{t-n+1:t})*sqrt(252) for daily sessions.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Returns, window, sample convention, annualization clock.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Not forward implied volatility; volatility clustering can bias iid assumptions.

indicator_entries.name: Average True Range (ATR)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Wilder RMA of true range, or other declared smoother.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Price-unit range volatility, useful for stops and position risk.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: ATR is not a direction or predicted variance.

indicator_entries.name: Normalized ATR (NATR)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: 100*ATR/C or other declared denominator.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Range volatility comparable across price levels.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Adjustment and penny-stock distortions possible.

indicator_entries.name: Bollinger Bands
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Center=SMA_n; bands=center +/- k*rolling_standard_deviation(P).
indicator_entries.interpretation: Relative price displacement and band width.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Closes, n, k, std ddof, warmup.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Band touch is not inherently reversal or breakout.

indicator_entries.name: Bollinger bandwidth / %B
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Bandwidth=(upper-lower)/center; %B=(C-lower)/(upper-lower).
indicator_entries.interpretation: Compression and price location inside/outside bands.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Compression is not proof an expansion will be tradable.

indicator_entries.name: Keltner channel
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: EMA(center) +/- k*ATR or other declared center/range convention.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Different platforms calculate materially different variants.

indicator_entries.name: Historical range estimators
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Parkinson uses high-low log range; Garman-Klass and Rogers-Satchell use OHLC expressions.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Properly adjusted OHLC and estimator conventions.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Gaps, jumps and drift violate some estimator assumptions.

indicator_entries.name: Yang-Zhang volatility
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Combines overnight, open-close and range components with a specified rolling estimator.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Choice of estimator parameters and overnight partition is material.

indicator_entries.name: Realized intraday variance
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Sum of squared intraday log returns across an explicitly sampled session.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Complete intraday observations and clock alignment.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Daily OHLCV cannot reconstruct realized intraday variance.

indicator_entries.name: Volatility-of-volatility
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Trailing variability of a volatility estimate or changes in IV.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Window overlap and sampling induce dependence.

indicator_entries.name: VIX / volatility-index observation
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Index value based on option-implied variance methodology.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Market-implied near-term variance proxy, not realized volatility.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: VIX is not a guaranteed future realized vol or a free tradable spot instrument.

indicator_entries.name: Volatility term structure
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Compare IV/volatility-index values across listed maturities.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Different maturities and delta conventions must be aligned.

indicator_entries.name: Volatility contraction ratio
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Short-window realized vol divided by longer-window realized vol.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Relative recent quiet versus historical baseline.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Threshold and regime definition must be prospective.

indicator_entries.name: Drawdown
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Equity_t/running_peak_equity-1 on causal realized portfolio equity.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Portfolio equity including fees/cash and chronological accounting.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Price drawdown is not strategy net drawdown.

indicator_entries.name: Share volume
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Number of shares transacted in period, as source-defined.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Timestamped shares, venue/provider coverage, corporate actions.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Share volume differs from notional traded value; consolidated vs venue-only matters.

indicator_entries.name: Dollar volume
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Price*share_volume, with declared trade/bar price proxy.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Corporate actions and split-adjusted volume must be consistent.

indicator_entries.name: Relative volume (RVOL)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Current completed volume / trailing comparable historical volume.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Unusually intense trading relative to baseline.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Comparing first 5 minutes with full-day volumes is invalid; normalizer as-of must be known.

indicator_entries.name: On-balance volume (OBV)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Cumulative +volume on up close, -volume on down close, zero otherwise.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: OBV is not true signed buyer-initiated order flow.

indicator_entries.name: Accumulation/Distribution Line (ADL)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Cumulative CLV*volume by bar.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Close location does not reveal informed order initiator.

indicator_entries.name: Chaikin Money Flow (CMF)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: sum(CLV*volume)/sum(volume) over trailing window.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Zero volume and gaps can distort interpretation.

indicator_entries.name: Session VWAP
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: sum(trade_price*trade_size)/sum(trade_size) over declared session; bar approximation separately labeled.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Actual trades or explicitly approximate bar data, session reset.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: VWAP cannot be known before its contributing trades; close-price approximation isn't exact.

indicator_entries.name: Anchored VWAP
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: VWAP beginning at a stated historically known event/time anchor.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Selecting the anchor after observing future returns introduces selection bias.

indicator_entries.name: Volume profile / volume-at-price
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Histogram of traded volume assigned to price bins over an explicit prior window.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Trades or high-resolution allocation approximation, bin rules.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: OHLC bar ranges cannot reveal true per-price volume distribution.

indicator_entries.name: Amihud illiquidity
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Mean(abs(return)/dollar_volume) over a lagged window.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Daily returns, dollar volume, unit contract.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Proxy, not a measured implementation shortfall; microcap and zero-volume treatment matters.

indicator_entries.name: Bid-ask spread
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Ask_quote - Bid_quote or relative midpoint spread.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: OHLC bars do not contain bid-ask spread; displayed quotes not necessarily executable size.

indicator_entries.name: Order-book imbalance
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: (bid_depth-ask_depth)/(bid_depth+ask_depth) at defined levels and time.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Cannot compute from OHLCV; spoofed/canceled depth is possible.

indicator_entries.name: Signed order flow / trade imbalance
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Aggressor-tagged buy minus sell trade volume or notional over interval.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Trade prints plus reliable aggressor classification.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: OHLCV, OBV, MFI and CLV cannot establish signed order flow.

indicator_entries.name: Kyle lambda / impact coefficient
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Estimated price change response to signed order flow, with model specified.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Price changes and trustworthy signed flow.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Endogeneity, simultaneity, and hidden liquidity limit causal inference.

indicator_entries.name: Execution shortfall / implementation shortfall
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Realized execution cost relative to decision/arrival benchmark including all fills and fees.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Decision timestamp/price, fills, order sizing, fees.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Backtest proxy is not broker-executed shortfall.

indicator_entries.name: Opening range
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: High/low observed during fixed early-session interval.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: The completed opening range is not known before its interval ends.

indicator_entries.name: Inside bar / outside bar
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Inside H_t<=H_prev and L_t>=L_prev; outside H_t>=H_prev and L_t<=L_prev under pinned equality policy.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Compression or expansion relative to previous bar.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: An inside bar is a pattern, not an entry order.

indicator_entries.name: Engulfing / candlestick patterns
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Rules on consecutive OHLC bodies/wicks, direction, gaps.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Completed OHLC and precise inclusion/equality rules.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Names alone are ambiguous and not evidence of predictive edge.

indicator_entries.name: Pivot high / pivot low
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Local extrema often require bars AFTER the candidate pivot.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Must timestamp first knowable confirmation; cannot trade retrospectively at pivot bar.

indicator_entries.name: Support/resistance zone
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Prior repeatedly observed highs/lows or traded-volume price concentrations.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Past timestamps, zone width, discovery algorithm.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Chart annotations and fitted zones are not objectively known ex ante without rules.

indicator_entries.name: False breakout / failed break
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Price exceeds prior known boundary then returns inside by declared confirmation.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Prior boundary, completed bars, confirmation time.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: No order-book evidence of stops from OHLC alone.

indicator_entries.name: Gap fill
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Future price traverses a stated part of a past session gap.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Causally defined prior gap and later prices.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: A gap filling in hindsight is not a forecast or guaranteed fill.

indicator_entries.name: Volatility squeeze / compression
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Price range or band width below predeclared trailing percentile.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Breakout direction and cost feasibility remain unresolved.

indicator_entries.name: Market breadth
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Fraction/count of universe members advancing, above MA, at highs, etc.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Today’s surviving tickers cannot stand in for historical constituents.

indicator_entries.name: Relative strength versus benchmark
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Cumulative security return minus benchmark return over pinned lookback.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Simple differential may not beta-neutralize market exposure.

indicator_entries.name: Beta
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Cov(r_asset,r_benchmark)/Var(r_benchmark) over historical window.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Estimated beta drifts, may be unstable at short windows.

indicator_entries.name: Alpha/intercept (regression)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Regression intercept under explicit risk model.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Statistical alpha is not necessarily after-cost executable trading alpha.

indicator_entries.name: Residual / idiosyncratic return
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: r_asset minus fitted model exposure*factor return with as-of coefficients.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Security movement not explained by selected common factors.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Factor histories and point-in-time fitted betas.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Fitting betas using evaluation future leaks information.

indicator_entries.name: Cross-sectional rank / percentile
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Rank eligible instruments by chosen feature at each valid decision time.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Point-in-time universe and comparable feature units.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Rank ties, missing data, delistings and eligibility matter.

indicator_entries.name: Z-score
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Z_t=(X_t-mu_past)/sigma_past on declared historical lookback.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Past feature values, lookback and zero-scale policy.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Use only past normalization statistics; outliers break Gaussian intuition.

indicator_entries.name: Pairs spread / hedge ratio
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: S_t=log(P_A)-beta*log(P_B) or declared linear combination.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Synchronized prices and hedge ratio estimated as-of.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Cointegration/stationarity must be tested; not automatically market neutral.

indicator_entries.name: Rolling correlation
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Correlation of two synchronized trailing return streams.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Correlation does not imply causation or stable hedge effectiveness.

indicator_entries.name: Momentum factor exposure
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Loading or portfolio return on predefined momentum factor.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: As-of factor series/universe and regression spec.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Factor performance is not necessarily independently tradable.

indicator_entries.name: Value factor
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Valuation characteristics/rank such as book-to-market under PIT accounting.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: PIT statements, as-of publication, point-in-time shares.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Price-only OHLCV cannot recreate true value fundamentals.

indicator_entries.name: Quality/profitability factor
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Rank by profitability, balance sheet strength or accounting stability.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: PIT filings and revisions, fiscal calendars.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Do not backfill revised filings to prior decision dates.

indicator_entries.name: Size and liquidity factor
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Market cap or liquidity characteristic with dated shares/volume.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: PIT shares, prices, universe, optional quote data.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Current market capitalization is not historical market cap.

indicator_entries.name: Earnings announcement surprise
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Actual disclosed result minus market expectation formed before release.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Release timestamp and frozen pre-release consensus.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Positive earnings growth alone is not surprise.

indicator_entries.name: Post-earnings announcement drift (PEAD)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Abnormal returns after timestamped earnings surprise over declared horizon.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Event PIT, adjusted bars, benchmark and tradable clock.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Not proof every earnings release creates drift; separate after-hours gaps.

indicator_entries.name: Guidance revision
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Change in management forecast relative to prior public guidance.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Release, publication and vendor ingest delays differ.

indicator_entries.name: Dividend yield
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Forward or trailing distributions divided by appropriate price on declared as-of basis.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Announced future dividend is not known before announcement.

indicator_entries.name: Buybacks / issuance
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Net share count change or publicly disclosed authorized repurchase.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Authorization to repurchase is not proof shares were bought.

indicator_entries.name: Short interest / days to cover
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Reported shares short; DTC=short_interest/average_daily_share_volume.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Reported publication time, settlement reference, ADV.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Publication delay; no daily exact short interest from OHLCV.

indicator_entries.name: Insider transaction
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Reported executive/director open-market trade as published.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Filed forms with transaction and dissemination times.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Transaction date may precede investor-knowable filing date.

indicator_entries.name: Institutional ownership / flows
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Holdings/ownership changes from dated reports or fund-flow series.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: PIT filings or authorized fund flows.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Quarterly disclosures are delayed and incomplete; cannot infer actual trade dates exactly.

indicator_entries.name: Index inclusion/deletion event
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Announcement/effective dates and membership changes.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Timestamped index decisions and PIT membership.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Index membership may be anticipated; effective date differs from announcement.

indicator_entries.name: Economic surprise (macro)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Released statistic minus consensus forecast frozen before release.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Unexpected information, not simply whether release was positive.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Final revised data cannot substitute for real-time releases.

indicator_entries.name: News sentiment / finance lexicon
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Score text polarity using declared model and timestamps.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Tone proxy, not proof of valuation news.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Licensed/public text, publication/availability times, model version.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Different topics/negation can invalidate generic lexicons.

indicator_entries.name: Article novelty / near-duplicate score
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Similarity to previously available public texts, measured using frozen embeddings or tokens.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Distinguishes first report from repeated story.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Timestamped corpus with source, text hashes, embedding version.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: A story cannot be labeled novel using articles published later.

indicator_entries.name: Attention / search-interest index
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Vendor search query/news/social activity observed at timestamp.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: PIT index with publication latency and vendor methodology.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Backfilled or normalized final series may leak future data.

indicator_entries.name: Social volume / discussion count
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Count timestamped messages matching a declared entity/topic over window.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Permitted archived posts, bot filtering, timestamped API.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Discussion count is not buy/sell imbalance or guaranteed demand.

indicator_entries.name: Headline versus filing discrepancy
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Separate language tone from quantitative surprise in same event.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Tests narrative vs substantive new information.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: PIT headline and filing, consensus, timing.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: A model's narrative explanation is not causal identification.

indicator_entries.name: Stale/reprinted news
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Repeated facts in later stories relative to first known disclosure.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Text lineage and exact first-public timestamps.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Cannot classify by final corpus hindsight.

indicator_entries.name: Earnings crowding / competing attention
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Number of independent important disclosures simultaneously observable.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Count of future day's full events is unavailable early in that day.

indicator_entries.name: News burst / event clustering
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Events per past interval with source and topic dedup.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Multiple articles can repeat one underlying fact.

indicator_entries.name: Policy / central bank communication tone
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Structured changes versus expectation around timestamped policy remarks.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: PIT speech/transcript, release time, anticipated consensus.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Text at later transcript publication may not have been instantly available.

indicator_entries.name: Option intrinsic value
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Call=max(S-K,0); put=max(K-S,0).
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Does not include time value or exercise costs.

indicator_entries.name: Implied volatility (IV)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Volatility solving chosen pricing model for observed option price.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Risk-neutral pricing input, not direct realized-vol forecast.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: PIT bid/ask/last, strike, maturity, rates, dividends, style.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Model, stale quotes and spread influence IV; OHLCV cannot produce an authoritative surface.

indicator_entries.name: Delta / gamma / vega / theta / rho
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Model sensitivities to underlying, curvature, IV, time, and rates.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Complete option terms and model inputs.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Greek conventions, units and dividends differ; gamma risks are nonlinear.

indicator_entries.name: IV skew / smile
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: IV differences by strikes or deltas at matched maturity.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Simple skew proxies cannot infer an executable options strategy without chain/fees.

indicator_entries.name: IV term structure
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: IV at comparable moneyness across expiries.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Different expiries need calendarized variance not naive IV subtraction for some comparisons.

indicator_entries.name: Open interest
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Outstanding contracts as reported by exchange/vendor.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Position stock, not same-day net initiating flow.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: OI is typically delayed and not direct order imbalance.

indicator_entries.name: Put/call ratio
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Puts/calls by declared traded volume or OI basis.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Volume-based and OI-based ratios are distinct.

indicator_entries.name: Option assignment/exercise exposure
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Lifecycle contingent on option style, deliverable, expiration, and assignment.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Contract master, corporate actions, exchange rules.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Cannot infer guaranteed assignment from theoretical in-the-money status.

indicator_entries.name: Futures basis
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Futures price minus spot/reference price under declared units/contract.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Roll gaps in continuous series are synthetic unless adjustment rules pinned.

indicator_entries.name: Contango/backwardation
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Term-structure relation across actual contract expiries.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: PIT term structure, settlement and contract specs.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Not automatically positive/negative realized roll yield.

indicator_entries.name: Roll yield proxy
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Return effect from holding/rolling a futures exposure using exact contract schedule.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Contracts, roll dates, collateral and fees.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Cannot infer investable futures return from stitched unadjusted continuous prices.

indicator_entries.name: FX carry / interest differential
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Currency interest-rate differential with FX forward price and funding assumptions.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Higher yield includes depreciation/crash/funding risk; not free profit.

indicator_entries.name: Funding rate (perpetual futures)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Periodic contract transfer paid by long or short per exchange contract.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Exchange timestamp, instrument terms, position, fees.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Cannot assume funding is constant or executable in spot prices.

indicator_entries.name: Term structure / basis trade hedge
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Long/short contract mix designed to isolate basis exposure.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Requires multi-leg execution and liquidation/venue risk accounting.

indicator_entries.name: Sharpe ratio
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Mean strategy excess return / standard deviation of strategy excess return with stated annualization.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Return per unit of total return variability.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Causal net returns, risk-free proxy, sample clock.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Short samples, autocorrelation and selection bias inflate apparent certainty.

indicator_entries.name: Sortino ratio
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Excess mean return / downside deviation below declared target.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Small downside samples may make it unstable.

indicator_entries.name: Calmar ratio
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Annualized net return / absolute max drawdown over declared interval.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Return versus realized worst peak-to-trough loss.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Path and measurement horizon matter.

indicator_entries.name: Profit factor
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Gross realized profits / absolute gross realized losses.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Realizable trade P&L inclusive of appropriate economics.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Undefined when no losses; not necessarily evidence of robust edge.

indicator_entries.name: Expectancy per trade
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Win_probability*avg_win + loss_probability*avg_loss (loss negative).
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Actual net trade results and matching population.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Correlated trades and regime changes impair independence.

indicator_entries.name: Turnover
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Sum of absolute position changes normalized on declared units/notional/time.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Can be double-counted if buy and sell conventions differ.

indicator_entries.name: Deflated Sharpe Ratio (DSR)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Statistical adjustment for nonnormality/selection under explicit method and number of comparisons.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Complete selection population and return moments.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Winner-only trials invalidate the denominator.

indicator_entries.name: Probability of Backtest Overfitting (PBO)
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: CSCV-based probability selected in-sample winner underperforms out of sample per frozen protocol.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Comparable registered trials, adequate independent observations.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Cannot compute honestly from tiny/incomparable/hidden trial populations.

indicator_entries.name: Cost-aware benchmark alpha
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Causally executed net strategy return minus declared capital-matched benchmark return under compatible exposure.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Strategy and benchmark with same capital/execution assumptions.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Raw return minus buy-and-hold can mislead when leverage/risk differ.

indicator_entries.name: Value at Risk / expected shortfall
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Quantile loss estimate and expected loss beyond quantile under chosen return model.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Tail observations scarce; ES not a maximum possible loss.

indicator_entries.name: Capacity / participation
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Requested trade shares or notional relative to executed/available market volume at event time.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Theoretical capacity isn't broker fill evidence.

indicator_entries.name: Slippage
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Realized fill price versus declared benchmark or simulated conservative fill cost.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Decision price, fills or approved model, side and size.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Worst-case assumptions must stay conservative; negative slippage must not be allowed to create artificial alpha.

indicator_entries.name: Trend continuation entry
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Enter aligned with a predeclared lagged trend state after a specified completed observation.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Supported trend indicator, trigger, sizing, exit, timeframe.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Breakouts and MA crossovers may be duplicate economic families; no same-bar close fill by hindsight.

indicator_entries.name: Mean-reversion entry
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Trade against a measured short-term move conditional on frozen reversion regime.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Oversold is not certainty; news-driven repricing can persist.

indicator_entries.name: Price-channel breakout
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Trade a crossing of prior-window H/L boundary at later executable time.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Prior n-bar extrema, confirmation, execution rule.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Do not use current high to set the prior boundary.

indicator_entries.name: Breakout failure / fade
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: After observing failed acceptance beyond prior boundary, take opposite direction on declared confirmation.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Failure confirmation must precede order; not guaranteed mean reversion.

indicator_entries.name: Volatility-contraction breakout
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Predeclared low-volatility setup plus independently observed range break.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Parameter sweep counts toward multiple testing.

indicator_entries.name: Gap reversal
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: After known open gap, evaluate later reversal with explicit order time.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Open, prior close, corporate action, trade clock.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: No fills at known opening price after seeing the opening gap unless proven executable.

indicator_entries.name: Gap continuation
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: After known open gap, evaluate directionally aligned continuation.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Information diffusion or persistent demand hypothesis.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Distinguish post-gap effect from same gap return.

indicator_entries.name: Close-to-open overnight effect
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Take position at executable close or earlier based only on signals known before that execution, then exit at later open.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Trading clock, corporate actions, allowed order cutoffs.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Closing auction order must be submitted before cutoff; cannot predict completed close and fill there.

indicator_entries.name: Cross-sectional momentum rotation
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Rank PIT universe on lagged returns, hold leading securities subject to specified rebalance/risk.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: PIT universe, data, ranking, allocation, short rules.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Survivorship bias and synchronized timestamps matter.

indicator_entries.name: Short-horizon reversal basket
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Rank prior losers/winners for a prospectively frozen contrarian basket.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: PIT universe, borrow/cost data for shorts, ranking.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Gross reversals can disappear after spread/impact.

indicator_entries.name: Pairs mean-reversion spread
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Enter when as-of-estimated spread deviates and exit under declared convergence rule.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Synchronized prices, hedge ratio, feasible short.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: No guaranteed cointegration or borrow availability.

indicator_entries.name: Calendar seasonality
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Trade an explicit month/week/holiday trading-session window declared before outcomes.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Authoritative session calendar, published holidays, corporate action.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Trading-session vs calendar-day distinctions are economically material.

indicator_entries.name: Post-earnings drift
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Trade only after publicly disseminated earnings surprise, during future executable window.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Announcement after close may require next session; no final revised surprise.

indicator_entries.name: News novelty continuation/reversal
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Conditional returns after genuinely new, timestamped and authorized public information.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: PIT news archive, duplicates, availability delay, price.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Text sentiment alone cannot distinguish information from pressure.

indicator_entries.name: High-volume shock conditional path
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Prospectively compare continuation/reversal after signed market-residual price shock and volume regime.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: OHLCV, market benchmark, pre-event vol, controls.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Daily OHLCV volume is not signed order flow; diagnosis often not executable signal.

indicator_entries.name: Institutional flow event
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Test price response to timestamped fund/index flow or inclusion announcement.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: PIT flow disclosures/index calendar, holdings, costs.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Flow proxy often delayed or unidentifiable from bars.

indicator_entries.name: Liquidity regime gate
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Allow/reject entry based on historical spread, ADV, volatility or borrow feasibility.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Declared liquidity proxy with correct data.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Often should be treated as risk filter rather than new strategy.

indicator_entries.name: Volatility targeting
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Position size proportional to risk budget divided by lagged volatility.
indicator_entries.interpretation: Risk scaling rather than directional alpha.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: May increase risk in low-volatility regimes; not automatic proof of improved returns.

indicator_entries.name: Risk halt / kill-switch event
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Restrictive action triggered by authorized threshold or broker/reconciliation condition.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Canonical risk/OMS authority and durable halt state.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: AI cannot clear halt or increase limits; a suggestion is not operational authority.

indicator_entries.name: Stop-loss / trailing stop
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Exit conditional on predetermined market price or trailing risk level.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Order type, intrabar execution model, held position, venue.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Price gaps and bar ambiguity can produce worse fills; stop is not guaranteed price.

indicator_entries.name: Profit target
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Exit/scale at a predeclared price or return threshold.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Entry fills, held qty, target and order clock.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Cannot assume high touched before stop within same OHLC bar.

indicator_entries.name: Time stop
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Exit after defined elapsed bars/sessions or decision timestamp.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Authoritative session calendar and entry clock.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Elapsed calendar days are not market sessions.

indicator_entries.name: Regime-gated candidate
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Combine primary signal with lagged trend/volatility/liquidity state.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: All indicator identities and gating order.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: A filter tested after seeing results is another trial, not free rescue.

indicator_entries.name: Long/short market neutral
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Hold opposite exposures under frozen beta/dollar/sector neutrality target.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: PIT universe, borrow, factor betas, capital accounting.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Nominal dollar-neutral does not imply beta-neutral or short feasibility.

indicator_entries.name: Options volatility spread
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Enter option structure based on IV versus expected realized vol under specified hedge and lifecycle.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: PIT option chain, Greeks, contract metadata, margin and assignment.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Cannot implement using underlying OHLCV alone; max loss and tails may be nonlinear.

indicator_entries.name: Futures term structure carry
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Hold/roll defined futures exposure conditional on real spread/carry.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Futures chains, exact rolls, collateral, fees.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Do not backtest continuous synthetic chart as executable contract P&L.

indicator_entries.name: FX carry or reversal
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Currency exposure based on PIT rate differential or prior move.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Spot direction alone omits financing, spread, settlement and leverage.

indicator_entries.name: No-trade decision
indicator_entries.definition_or_formula: Explicit decision to refrain because gate failed, data stale, risk refused or signal absent.
indicator_entries.required_inputs: Valid evaluation and refusal reason with timestamp.
indicator_entries.causal_and_data_caveat: Truthful no-trade is not an imaginary zero-fill broker event.

runtime_authority: NONE: MQD deterministic registry/strategy/backtest/promotion interfaces own all executable authority
